summary: Re-ran the 3 suite failures against the live game (human not busy): ball-rally camera and butterfly chase fail again; the cairn carry test passed alone (flaky in the full suite). I added no new tests.

failures.what: Ball rally: the camera does not frame the critters passing the ball
failures.steps: live_tests("Critters pass the ball") (failed in the suite and alone)
failures.expected: The camera looks at the rally (within about 30 degrees of the view line)
failures.actual: Off by [1.9, 50.3, 5.0] degrees in the suite and [55.6, 61.8, 58.1] alone

failures.what: Butterflies: nobody chases a butterfly after Sprout walks into the flower field
failures.steps: live_tests("Butterflies: Sprout"). It failed in the suite and alone. Nearest critter is a follower (Cumulus :follow 0.8 m, earlier Gloop :follow 1.6 m); the others are :fish, :wander, :interact, :sunbathe or :pebble, 12 m or more away
failures.expected: A free critter within 7 m, or a parade friend, shouts 'Butterflies!' and runs after one
failures.actual: No critter gets a :chase goal. The near follower keeps :follow, and the free critters are all further than 7 m

failures.what: Cairn: the carried pebble is not set down within the test time (flaky)
failures.steps: Full suite: Sprout 2.5 m from the cairn, carrying false, count went 178 to 180. Alone the test passed in 17 s
failures.expected: Sprout sets the stone on the cairn
failures.actual: Fails in the full suite only. Probably a leftover from an earlier test (state or position) or the :pebble goal replaced early (todo #230)
